description.value: Yokidomo Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on West Saanich Road in Victoria offering a broad menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, donburi, noodles, bento boxes, and party trays, with a newer Korean Fried Chicken section. The menu is notably diverse in dietary options, with many dishes explicitly marked gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan. Located in a strip-mall unit, it serves as a practical sit-down meal stop for cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content (Wix site) confirms the business name, phone number (+1 250 590 1988), and provides an address (4-4517 West Saanich Rd, Victoria BC) not present in OSM tags. The menu pages explicitly label many items as Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten free, providing positive evidence for that amenity. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site. OSM lists closing time as 21:00 but the website states 8:00pm (20:00) — a discrepancy worth flagging.
